existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: No hard local R4→R6 validation break was found for existing `AppointmentResponse` elements. The top migration concerns are the R6-only `entered-in-error` status, R6-only recurrence/counter-proposal fields, `Group` actors, and codegen/rendering changes from `comment: string` to `comment: markdown`. The main uncertainty is exact `participantType` terminology expansion impact.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: R4→R6 migration should preserve all existing common fields, then enrich records where possible: derive `proposedNewTime` from business context when start/end differ from the referenced Appointment, map recurrence intent into the new recurrence fields when known, and update status enums to include `entered-in-error`. R6→R4 conversion needs explicit loss handling for `entered-in-error`, `Group` actors, and recurrence-specific fields because R4 has no native slots for them.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural deltas because both assigned StructureDefinitions are present and have the same canonical identity. Confidence is high for `participantStatus` because local ValueSets and CodeSystems show the added code. Confidence is medium for `participantType` because the R6 value set references external terminology package versions whose full expansions were not available in the supplied core package.
